title: Measurability of a coordinate indicator
statement: For every natural number $k$ and coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$, the function on Boolean vectors of length $k$ that equals $1$ when coordinate $i$ is true and $0$ otherwise is measurable.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate in a Boolean vector of length $k$
